{{Quote|That ship is alive with the dark side, Master Yoda. I can feel it clinging to my robes. And worse, it still tempts me, calling me back with promises of fantastic journeys to the far reaches of the galaxy.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]|<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels" />}}
The '''''Scimitar''''', also known as the '''Sith Infiltrator''', or just '''The Infiltrator''' before Maul gave it its name, was a prototype stealth-ship used as the personal starship of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|There exists no other ship like it.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] when granting the ''Scimitar'' to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="SW DM 1" />}}
[[File:Scimitar_deckplan_SotG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Scimitar''{{'s}} deckplan.]]
The ''Scimitar'' had a pair of folding wings around a round cockpit; a design which was used on [[T-class long-range personal cruiser/Legends|T-class long-range personal cruisers]] like the ''[[Valcyn/Legends|Valcyn]]'' which were used by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] like [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] during the [[New Sith Wars]] [[1000 BBY/Legends|about a millennium earlier]] and would later resurface in the famous [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of starfighters used primarily by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

In front of the round cockpit (the whole forward-center section of the spacecraft) of the vehicle was a rare [[Stygium/Legends|stygium crystal]]-powered [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] for creating an invisibility field. This enabled the ship to sneak through even the most advanced of security technologies and allowed its master to evade pursuit while on his missions.

Built beneath the cloak field generator was a series of compartments containing various equipment for Darth Maul's missions including three [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droids]], his speeder bike [[Bloodfin/Legends|''Bloodfin'']], several [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation]] droids and several [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], spying equipment, [[Torture/Legends|torture]] devices, bombs and mines.

The Infiltrator was protected by six low-profile [[Solar ionization cannon/Legends|solar ionization cannons]] which could extend and fire several bursts in the blink of an eye. It was also equipped with an experimental high temperature [[X-C 2 ion drive array/Legends|X-C 2 ion drive array]] which would resurface in future Sienar designs while the ship's hyperdrive was an unmodified [[SSDS 11-A/Legends|SSDS 11-A]]. It could also carry six passengers while its total capacity was 2.5 metric tons.

==History==
[[File:Sith_Infiltrator_TPM.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Scimitar'' travels to Tatooine.]]
The ''Scimitar'' was an extensively modified version of a [[Sienar Design Systems/Legends|Sienar Design Systems]]<ref name="CCS" /> prototype for<ref name="Starships">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> an advanced [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]].<ref name="CCS" /> It was designed by the famed starship designer, Rugess Nome, who was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], built by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] for Tenebrous's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], and delivered to Plagueis on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Plagueis used the ship to escape from an [[Bombing of Sojourn|attack]] on his [[Damask fortress|fortress]] on Sojourn by a coalition of forces hired by the King of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]]. He cloaked the ship and rendezvoused with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and his ship, the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']]. Plagueis later bequeathed the courier to his apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who had requested the ship be built as a gift for [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Having survived a dangerous training session with deadly [[Duelist Elite/Legends|combat droids]], Darth Maul was sent on a mission by Lord Sidious to kill the leading [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] of the powerful [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate which dominated a significant amount of crime in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. For this mission, Maul was equipped with the courier,<ref name="SW DM 1" /> which he would christen ''Scimitar''.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> The Sith apprentice then left his master's base in the galactic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] cloaked by its powerful stygium powered-cloaking device and passed over the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] itself, which only caused a slight disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="SW DM 1" />

After disposing of the Black Sun vigos including Master [[Alexi Garyn]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]],<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Darth Maul returned the ''Scimitar'' to Coruscant while hunting the Trade Federation traitor [[Hath Monchar]].<ref name="SH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Following the completion of that mission,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Maul was assigned by his master to track down the missing [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], along with her entourage and her pair of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] guardians Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan. After breaking through the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] blockade on Naboo, Amidala and her guardians made their way to the remote desert planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Thanks to the enhanced features of the Scimitar and its complement of spy droids, it was to this locale that Darth Maul finally tracked & confronted Master Qui-Gon, who only narrowly escaped.<ref name="TPM" />

However, Darth Maul would later meet his foes again during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends#Duel in Theed|Battle of Naboo]],<ref name="TPM" /> landing the ''Scimitar'' just outside Trade Federation-controlled [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] in a [[secure private hangar]] provided to him by his master.<ref name="End Game">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref> The Sith Lord managed to kill Qui-Gon Jinn, before being [[Sai tok/Legends|bisected]] and seemingly killed by Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="TPM" /> Following that, the ''Scimitar'' passed into the hands of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels" />

[[File:Sith_Infiltrator_hatch.png|thumb|left|250px|Sith Infiltrator while landed, with the ship's landing ramp extended.]]
The first technicians to inspect the courier were killed by automated defenses, so Jedi Master [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] was tasked to help in securing the craft. While he found a large amount of equipment, including torture devices and other less-sinister pieces of technology, the onboard computers had been erased. The ship was going to be transferred over to [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for study, but disappeared somewhere en route according to official records.<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels" /> In reality, as of [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Republic was storing it in a clandestine hangar in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> The ''Scimitar'' remained in Darth Sidious's possession during his reign as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Starships" />

The ''Scimitar'' was an influence in the creation of the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', which was similarly produced by a [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar company]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
<div style="float:right">[[File:Scimitar_views.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Dorsal and bow views of ''Scimitar''.]]</div>
In ''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]'', the ship is referred to as the ''Infiltrator''.

In the book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', there is a ship that looks very much like the ''Scimitar'' in the section on [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].
On the deckplan of the ''Scimitar'' from [[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]], the ''Scimitar's'' cockpit and airlock are shown to be on different levels, while in the book ''[[Episode I Adventures 3: The Fury of Darth Maul]]'', Maul is said to have seen a [[Bartokk]] reflected in the cockpit viewscreen, while seated in the pilot's chair, and opened the airlock directly behind himself to vent the assassin.

The ''Scimitar'' is playable in the last bonus mission in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. In another video game, [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], released in [[2001]], the ''Scimitar'' can be unlocked by beating all story-based missions with a "Gold" rank, or by entering the code "SIENAR&!" in the N64 version or "FRBPTDAY" in the PC version. The vehicle is equipped with specially powerful weapons that make gameplay easy&mdash;laser cannons and two fire-linked [[seeker missile]] launchers.
